question: Which of the following bills was introduced in the Rajya Sabha by the Ministry of Law and Justice on 10 August 2023?

options.text: The Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Tenure) Bill, 2023

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Tenure) Bill, 2023**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioners (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Tenure) Bill, 2023** was introduced in the Rajya Sabha by the Ministry of Law and Justice on 10 August 2023.
 
• This bill outlines the procedures for the appointment, conditions of service, and tenure of the Chief Election Commissioner and other Election Commissioners.
 
• The introduction of this bill aims to provide clarity and transparency in the appointment process and to ensure the independence and impartiality of the Election Commission of India.
 
• The bill is a significant step towards strengthening the electoral process and upholding the democratic framework of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Election Commission of India** is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering election processes in India at both the national and state levels.
 
• It was established on 25 January 1950 in accordance with the Constitution.
 
• The body administers elections to the Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, and State Legislative Assemblies, as well as the offices of the President and Vice President in the country.
 
• The Commission operates under the authority of the Constitution per Article 324 and subsequently enacted Representation of the People Act.
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner and other Election Commissioners are appointed by the President of India.
 
• The introduction of this bill is in line with the efforts to ensure a robust electoral mechanism and to enhance the credibility of the Election Commission.
